description: This file sets up and renders the ListView for the 'Groups' module in SuiteCRM, including initialization of the ListView object, template, query, and rendering process.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the rendering and management of list views in the SuiteCRM interface.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the template for the list view using the specified HTML template file and language strings.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title of the list view table.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the SQL WHERE clause, order, and filters for retrieving list view data.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Produces the list view output based on the focus bean and specified display parameters.
